title: About us & mission
lead: Medstudy Academy, z. s. is a registered nonprofit association (spolek) in the Czech Republic. We help foreigners, healthcare workers and families integrate through free education, counselling and community support.
mission: To provide practical, free support for people who are integrating into Czech society — especially foreigners, healthcare professionals and families — through education, orientation and community programmes. Official decisions on visas, admissions and professional licences always remain with the competent authorities; our role is nonprofit guidance and support.
whoParagraphs: We are Medstudy Academy, z. s. (also presented publicly as MedStudyacademy z.s.), a nonprofit association founded to help people in difficult life situations find a path in the Czech Republic.

Our team includes professionals and volunteers who know relocation from personal experience. We work with university applicants, healthcare workers and families who need language, document and everyday orientation.
All educational programmes, counselling and cultural activities we offer to beneficiaries are provided free of charge.
whatIntro: Our main programme areas are described in more detail on dedicated pages:

whatItems.title: Educational programmes
whatItems.description: Czech language courses, subject preparation and adaptation modules for foreigners.

whatItems.title: Support for healthcare workers
whatItems.description: Orientation for doctors, dentists and nurses on approval and integration steps.

whatItems.title: Social and cultural activities
whatItems.description: Community meetings that reduce isolation and support belonging.

whatItems.title: Counselling
whatItems.description: Individual advice on documents, legalisation, employment and adaptation.

whatItems.title: Partnerships and projects
whatItems.description: Cooperation with public institutions, universities and other NGOs.

whatItems.title: Additional support
whatItems.description: Help with housing searches, paperwork and specialist meetings when available.

audienceItems: University applicants planning Czech higher education
Healthcare workers seeking lawful practice in Czechia
Foreigners and families adapting to school, language and everyday life
